services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Looking for a fun way to build camaraderie and teamwork? Put your employees all in the same boat and learn to sail and maneuver a 160 foot schooner. Everyone on board begins the sail by working together to hoist up the Zodiac’s 4000 square foot mainsail and then breaks into small groups for instruction on specific sailing stations. As your crew work side by side to sail the ship they can experience how communication and coordination are essential to success. The sailing exercise can be followed up with a seminar down in the ship’s classic salon or sunset cocktail party on deck. Combine your celebration with an unforgettable sailing adventure. blurb: The Schooner Zodiac is a classic, 160-foot U.S. Coast Guard certified vessel, operated by a licensed captain and experienced team of volunteer crewmembers. She departs her Bellingham homeport for a variety of public and private charters, as well as day and evening sails from spring through fall, exploring the pristine anchorages of the San Juan Islands and Canadian Gulf Islands.
